title: Blasts Rattle Riyadh as Saudi Arabia Hit by Deadliest Houthi Attacks So Far
summary: Saudi-led forces in Yemen said they intercepted two missiles targeting Riyadh. The kingdom is on edge after the authorities said strikes killed three people on Wednesday.
